title: LLM call event
description: One line of the LLM event log: metadata about one call through the service layer. It never contains prompts, artifact text, model output or keys. Never sent to an LLM provider.

schema_version.description: Version (MAJOR.MINOR) of this event schema, so the log stays readable after the format changes.

run_id.description: Groups the calls of one run (one smoke check, one pipeline run). Generated once per run by build_llm unless the caller passes one.

request_id.description: The provider's ID for the response, when it returns one; useful when contacting provider support.

provider.description: For example cohere, or fake in tests.

agent.description: The role that made the call, for example decision-registrar or smoke-check.

error_type.description: Project exception class name, for example LLMRateLimitError. Present only when status is error.

error_message.description: The project exception's message. Present only when status is error; never prompts, artifact text or model output.

finish_reason.description: The provider's reason the model stopped, when it reports one, for example COMPLETE or MAX_TOKENS.

items.description: Texts embedded or documents reranked. 1 for chat.

input_tokens.description: Billed input tokens, when the provider reports them.

output_tokens.description: Billed output tokens, when the provider reports them.

raw_input_tokens.description: Input tokens actually processed, when the provider reports them separately from billed tokens.

raw_output_tokens.description: Output tokens actually generated, when the provider reports them separately from billed tokens.

search_units.description: Billed rerank search units, when the provider reports them.

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost as a decimal string. Omitted when the price table has no price for this model.

price_table.description: The checked_on date of the price table used for cost_usd.
